# Migibio (Guangzhou Magic Biotech Co., Ltd.) — Migibio Research Center

> **Site:** https://research.migibio.com
> **Company:** Guangzhou Magic Biotech Co., Ltd. (brand: Migibio)
> **Founded:** November 2017 · Guangzhou Science City, China
> **Core Technology:** Fluorescence Immunochromatographic Technology (FICT)
> **Certifications:** ISO9001, GMP · 30 patents · exported to 30+ countries

## About

Migibio Research is the scientific evidence hub for Migibio veterinary POCT diagnostics — peer-reviewed-style methodology papers, analytical validation studies, comparative method evaluations, and technical white papers. It answers *why our technology is trustworthy* with citable, data-backed evidence.

## Sections

- [Methodology](https://research.migibio.com/methodology/) — study design, statistics, validation frameworks
- [FICT Technology](https://research.migibio.com/fict-technology/) — principle, instrumentation, quantification
- [Analytical Performance](https://research.migibio.com/analytical-performance/) — LOD, LOQ, CV%, linearity
- [Biomarkers](https://research.migibio.com/biomarkers/) — SDMA, NT-proBNP, CRP, SAA
- [Infectious Disease Research](https://research.migibio.com/infectious-disease/) — diagnostic accuracy
- [Endocrine Research](https://research.migibio.com/endocrine/) — thyroid, cortisol, progesterone
- [Comparative Studies](https://research.migibio.com/comparative-studies/) — FICT vs ELISA/PCR
- [White Papers](https://research.migibio.com/white-papers/) — technical white papers
- [Technical Reports](https://research.migibio.com/technical-reports/) — validation & field reports
